content:
Hello Admin! 👋

I have access to all platform data. Ask me:
• **User summary** — how many users, by role, status
• **Top companies** — best rated, most projects
• **Pending approvals** — unapproved companies/suppliers
• **City analytics** — coverage gaps, demand
• **Market prices** — current material costs

What would you like to know?
whise companes and users have chatted with each other
I don't have that specific information in my database. Let me know if you’d like any other analytics—such as user totals, top‑rated companies, pending approvals, or current market prices.
